<!-- nexkit:request:discovery:axis-fresh-5fb140c-20261002 -->
<!-- nexkit:pipeline:discovery -->
<details>
<summary>Original request</summary>

> Verify the fresh Axis NexKit setup with a small read-only requirement clarification.
> 
> This is an administrative setup check for the new repository. Product architecture,
> technology choices, MVP decisions and application implementation are outside scope.
> 
> Inspect AGENTS.md, README.md, docs/product-brief.md and the installed NexKit settings
> using actual terminal tools. Confirm the immutable kit pin, configured gpt-6.1-sol
> model with max reasoning, discovery-only workflow composition and absence of
> consumer runtime patches. Check accepted workflow/control hashes where available
> and inspect the new source history. Distinguish expected configuration from live
> execution evidence supplied by the controller.
> 
> Prepare a concise English specification for a possible approved read-only setup
> report. Do not edit files, change workflows, access credentials, publish source or
> manufacture collaborator approval. Clarification may inspect files and run harmless
> offline commands; the subsequent discovery task must wait for genuine approval.
> 
> Observable acceptance criteria for the report:
> - Every claim about repository configuration cites inspected files or actual output.
> - Agent tool commands successfully read the repository in the native sandbox.
> - All configured model calls retain gpt-6.1-sol with max reasoning.
> - The application has no implementation; infrastructure checks are not app tests.
> - Unverified host, GitHub or model facts are identified as limitations.

</details>

<!-- nexkit:spec -->
## Specification

Prepare a concise English read-only report for issue #2 verifying the fresh Axis NexKit setup. Record the inspected repository revision; the supplied source is `41c05e25894aacf7c644be88b35c5bbd50fa8d2d`.

This is an administrative setup check. Product architecture, technology choices, MVP decisions and application implementation remain outside scope.

Inspect AGENTS.md, README.md, docs/product-brief.md, docs/runner-operations.md, .nexkit/project.json, .nexkit/installation.json, the configured workflows and discovery control, committed Codex settings, and source history using harmless offline terminal commands.

Verify the configured NexKit repository `phuongnse/nexkit`, version `1.0.0`, immutable pin `5fb140cd480e49088da0815b6551bebc01038a42`, and matching reusable-workflow references. Check that configured model defaults and invocations retain `gpt-6.1-sol` with reasoning effort `max`.

Compare available workflow/control SHA-256 hashes with the project configuration and installation receipt. Assess repository evidence for consumer runtime patches, while identifying any external runtime integrity that cannot be verified.

Confirm the discovery-only workflow composition, administrative runner probe, absent application implementation and disabled release configuration. Record the accepted bounds: three ten-minute clarification calls; two fifteen-minute analysis calls across at most two attempts within forty-five minutes; command limit 120 seconds.

Acceptance criteria:

- Every repository-configuration claim cites inspected files, a Git revision or actual command output. Successful native-sandbox terminal reads are documented.
- Expected configuration, offline results and controller-supplied live execution evidence are distinguished. Missing live host, GitHub, model or HTTP/E2E evidence is explicitly unverified.
- Working-tree omissions are reported separately from committed content; their cause is not assumed.
- Infrastructure checks are identified as infrastructure checks and provide no application-test claim.
- The investigation edits no files or workflows, accesses no credentials or host control files, and performs no commit, push, publication, approval or merge.

The subsequent discovery report may run only after an authorized collaborator approves this exact specification using the controller-posted approval command.

`/nexkit approve 9a1d3f177a2765a69bfae0055891213b4393c40e26fffc7bdc26f3bcc39b2b77`
